title: Live improvement log
summary: Operator-ordered rolling log (2026-08-18): the orchestrator records improvement observations from live supervision over the coming hours. Every entry is reconciled against in-flight cards and existing dossiers before it may propose new work - dedup is the core discipline. Entries carry one of three verdicts: covered-by (existing key), operator-action (no ticket needed, a hand must move), or new-candidate (becomes a card only after a second sighting or operator nod). [Curation 2026-09-07 (AGT-2671): stays in the active list as a standing rolling log rather than a single-decision dossier, and is not closable - no related task key is fully terminal yet. The former status "accepted" and phase "in-progress" were outside the descriptor vocabulary (status: active | decision-pending | decided | documented | archived, phase: informational | shaping | testing | decision-ready) and made this dossier render as "Descriptor needs repair"; the descriptor repair in develop corrected them to decided/testing, which this pass adopts because it keeps the log in the active list.]
